Bouncy & Firm Sleeping Mask Visibly Plump & Firm

An overnight cooling & hydrating eye treatment powered by the Korean “slow aging” skincare trend to depuff and firm skin around the eyes, while blurring under-eye lines.

Key Ingredient:

  • Caffeine
  • Niacinamide
  • Peony & Collagen Complex + Peptides

Skin Type:

All

Benefits:

Brighten
Derm Tested
Hydration

Formulated Without:

  • Parabens
  • Phthalates
  • Sulfates SLS & SLES
This Korean eye sleeping mask has a whipped gel texture that is silicone-free and provides a light layer over eye cream to lock in hydration. The Peony & Collagen Complex™ and Peptides help blur visible fine lines & wrinkles over time. Dermatologically tested, hypoallergenic, non-comedogenic, and safe to use around the eyes.

Shop All Masks

WATER / AQUA / EAU, GLYCERIN, SODIUM ACRYLATES CROSSPOLYMER-2, BUTYLENE GLYCOL, NIACINAMIDE, 1,2-HEXANEDIOL, PANTHENOL, POLYGLYCERIN-3, GLYCERYL POLYMETHACRYLATE, CAFFEINE, LACTOBACILLUS FERMENT LYSATE, ACRYLATES/C10-30 ALKYL ACRYLATE CROSSPOLYMER, PROPANEDIOL, XANTHAN GUM, DIPOTASSIUM GLYCYRRHIZATE, ETHYLHEXYLGLYCERIN, ADENOSINE, SODIUM METAPHOSPHATE, CAPRYLYL GLYCOL, TRYPTOPHAN, HYDROLYZED COLLAGEN, DEXTRIN, THEOBROMA CACAO (COCOA) EXTRACT, SODIUM HYALURONATE, CYANOCOBALAMIN, PAEONIA ALBIFLORA ROOT EXTRACT, TOCOPHEROL, HYDROLYZED HYALURONIC ACID, ACETYL TETRAPEPTIDE-2, SODIUM HYALURONATE CROSSPOLYMER, HYALURONIC ACID, PAEONIA ALBIFLORA FLOWER EXTRACT, SODIUM ACETYLATED HYALURONATE
Gently pat a light layer of the mask on top of hydrated skin around the eye area. This eye sleeping mask should be the last step of your skincare routine (make sure to apply over toner/moisturizer/eye cream/face sleeping mask).Use gentle dabbing motions to avoid pulling on the skin. After usage, close the lid tightly to prevent formula from drying out.
